items.title: TRAI Assesses Mobile Network Quality across Fazilka city and adjoining areas (in Punjab LSA)
items.summary: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) has released findings of Independent Drive Test (IDT) conducted across Fazilka city and adjoining areas (in Punjab LSA), during the month of August 2026, for information of general telecom consumers.
key_facts: The purpose of this drive test is to assess and verify real time quality of mobile network services (both voice & data) provided by Telecom Service Providers (TSPs).
These IDTs have been designed to capture on ground mobile network performance of all TSPs across diverse usages environment like cities, hotspots, public transport hubs, etc.

items.summary: Strengthening the Government’s commitment towards holistic river rejuvenation, the 20th Meeting of the Empowered Task Force (ETF) was held in New Delhi under the chairmanship of the Union Minister for Jal Shakti, Shri C. R. Paatil.
key_facts: The meeting reviewed the overall status of projects under the Namami Gange Programme and the programme’s performance during FY 2025-26.
As of August 2026, 527 projects have been sanctioned at a total cost of ₹43,266 crore, of which 368 projects have been completed.

items.title: Women Account for 43% of Overall Ayush Services Workforce; Representation Exceeds 50% Across Several Organised Segments
items.summary: The Ayush services sector is emerging as an important avenue for women’s participation in the workforce, with female representation exceeding 50 per cent across several organised segments, according to a recent assessment of the sector.
key_facts: Women account for 43 per cent of the overall Ayush services workforce, with their representation crossing 50 per cent in hospitals, day-care centres, educational institutes and wellness establishments.

The Ayush services economy, covering Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Sowa-Rigpa and Homoeopathy, was estimated at US$36.92 billion in FY2024-25, registering a robust 16.91 per cent CAGR since FY2022-23.
The sector directly supports an estimated 1.76 million livelihoods across healthcare, wellness, education and allied services.

items.title: NHRC, India concludes its two-day Bihar Open Hearing and Camp Sitting in Patna
items.summary: The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC), India led by Chairperson, Justice V. Ramasubramanian today concluded its two-day Bihar Open Hearing and Camp sitting in Patna.
key_facts: The Chairperson and Members, Justice (Dr.) Bidyut Ranjan Sarangi and Smt. Vijaya Bharathi Sayani heard more than 70 alleged cases of human rights violations in the presence of victims and concerned officers.
Preeta Verma, NHRC Secretary General, Shri Piyush Goyal, DG (I), Smt. Anupama Nilekar Chandra, Joint Secretary, Shri Samir Kumar and other senior officers were present.
Altogether, compensation exceeding Rs. 1 crore was reported as disbursed, marking a significant step in ensuring justice and redress for human rights violations.

items.title: NBA receives Rs 9.68 crore under Access and Benefit Sharing Framework during April–September 2026
items.summary: The National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) received Rs 9.68 crore from users of India's biological resources during the period from 01.04.2026 to 30.09.2026, in accordance with the Biological Diversity Act, 2002, as amended in 2023, and the ABS Regulations.
items.ministry: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
key_facts: Of the total receipts, Rs 9.56 crore was received towards access to biological resources from various sectors as given below.
The Agri-seed sector accounted for the largest share of receipts, with Rs 7.16 crore, followed by Food & Beverages at Rs 1.59 crore and Animal Husbandry at Rs 62.01 lakh.
Receipts classified under IPR-related applications amounted to Rs 11.24 lakh.

key_facts: He acknowledged the hard work of industry stakeholders in making these achievements possible.
Referring to the strengthening of the telecom sector over the last year, Dr Pemmasani stated that most of the rules under the Telecommunications Act, 2023 have now been notified.
The Minister of State further said that nearly 136 R&D projects, worth approximately ₹500 crore, have been funded under the Telecom Technology Development Fund (TTDF).

items.title: Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal Puts Global Partnerships, Youth & Women at the Heart of India's Maritime Future

items.ministry: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
key_facts: The ministers discussed the potential of the Manas and Sankosh rivers, and the connectivity with the national waterways for improved cargo movement.
Both the ministers discussed maritime training for Bhutanese youth at the Centre of Excellence in Dibrugarh which is being developed.
"Our talks with Saudi Arabia, Belgium and Bhutan show how India's maritime partnerships are growing across regions," said Sarbananda Sonowal.

items.title: Rural Development Ministry holds national level rural training centres meet
items.summary: A two-day National Level Review Meeting of Rural Self Employment Training Institutes (RSETI) Stakeholders was organised by the Ministry of Rural Development at Shillong, Meghalaya. The meeting is being organised in association with the Government of Meghalaya and the National Academy of RSETI (NAR).
key_facts: In his address, Shri Rohit Kansal, Secretary, described RSETI as a unique institutional model that brings together the Central Government, State Governments and the banking sector.
He emphasised that training is a means to the end, and that the ultimate objective is sustainable livelihoods through wage employment, entrepreneurship or self-employment.

He also highlighted opportunities in the international labour market, such as nursing, caregiving, plumbing and foreign-language skills, and asked governing bodies to revise courses that have not been updated recently.
